prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ composeDashboard }`. `composeDashboard(sections, viewportWidth)` receives an array of `{ key, heading, content }` records and a non-negative integer viewport width. All three record fields must be non-empty strings, and keys must be unique; otherwise throw `TypeError`. For widths below 640, return `{ mode: 'single', rows }` with one copied section per row. At widths of 640 or more, return `{ mode: 'paired', rows }` with consecutive sections grouped two per row; an odd final section occupies a one-item row. Preserve input order. Empty input produces an empty `rows` array. Neither the result nor later input mutations may alias each other. Implement a new, self-contained solution using only standard JavaScript.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
